The plate looks like a paper plate of about 20 cm, and it measures about 260 px across in the image. That gives roughly 0.77 mm per px, or about 13 px per cm.

I count about 12 grapes. Each is around 35 px long, which is roughly 2.7 cm, and that fits a large grape weighing about 6-8 g. At 7 g each, 12 grapes come to about 84 g.

Grapes provide about 0.69 kcal/g, so 84 g is about 58 kcal. Rounding up slightly for the larger grapes gives about 60 kcal.
